title: Phone walk-through: summary screen missing, and YOU SAID shows the last thing said instead of the item's own prompt

requirements.text: The cause of the missing summary screen is found and on the ticket, from evidence (code path or phone log)
requirements.check: manual: cause recorded with genlock cause, citing file:line

requirements.text: After a walk ends, the summary screen shows (unit test or on-device check)
requirements.check: eye: phone build shows the end screen after the last item

requirements.text: Each walk item's YOU SAID quotes the prompt that item's reply answers, not the newest thing said
requirements.check: test: bridge/Android unit test with two prompts and an out-of-order reply -> each item carries its own prompt

requirements.text: Fixed build is installed on TJ's Pixel
requirements.check: manual: adb install / ship script output with version

text: YOU SAID cause found: Link.kt:581 tags every item with the newest ME/laptop line at arrival, so unprompted replies (relay reports, load alerts, task notifications) quote whatever TJ said last. Bridge knows the turn's real prompt. Summary screen: ambiguous, asked TJ; separately the 14:46 status-update reply (fresh conversation 72ccc36b) never reached the bridge log.

fields.symptom: Arrival screen never showed while replies still read aloud; YOU SAID quoted TJ's newest words on every item, including replies he never prompted
fields.root_cause: State the code had was replaced by a guess or held in the wrong place: (1) the speaker toggle ('speak' pref) gated only the arrival call in MainActivity.onReply, never the Walker's voice, so muting hid the screen and kept the reading; (2) Link tagged items with the newest ME/laptop line because the bridge never sent which prompt began the turn
whys: speak predates the digest: replies were read by TTS in onReply; reading moved into Walker and the gate stayed at the old call site
the follower tracked where the last prompt came from (lastSource), not what it was, and event-begun turns (relay, alerts, task notifications) were not turn starts for it
fields.corrective: Arrival always shows; speaker off makes the whole walk silent (Walker.speakOn: no clips or TTS, no mic, reading-time countdown). Bridge sends re/reOf from the turn's own prompt (TranscriptFollower.lastPrompt), empty for event-begun turns; phone uses WalkPlan.youSaid
fields.preventive: follower.test.mjs 'each reply carries the prompt that began its turn' and WalkPlanTest youSaid* tests; arrive() logs 'arrival skipped: <why>' to the bridge log so a missing screen is visible
fields.gate: npm test in mobile/bridge and gradlew testDebugUnitTest before a phone build

evidence: Phone prefs (run-as cat genlock-ui.xml) showed speak=false; MainActivity.kt onReply called walker.arrive() only inside if (prefs().getBoolean("speak", true)), while Walker read items regardless. TJ confirmed 'Arrival screen' (Q-23TD9) and 'if the mic is off, it doesnt show the arrival screen, but it still reads everything'. Cause recorded with genlock cause.

mobile/bridge npm test 47/47 incl. follower 'each reply carries the prompt that began its turn' (phone/laptop prompts carried, relay/load alert/task-notification -> null, queued phone words replace); gradlew testDebugUnitTest WalkPlanTest 17/17 incl. youSaidQuotesThePhoneMessageTheBridgeNames, youSaidIsEmptyForAReplyNobodyPrompted. Bridge restarted (launchctl kickstart) 21:55:49.
./phone.sh --device 'Pixel 10 Pro' -> Success, installed and opened; dumpsys versionName=0.1.456375

text: spun off T-P3PEM: Status-update replies from a fresh Assistant conversation reach the phone, and Mac load alerts stop counting as TJ at the laptop

evidence: TJ clarified the summary screen is the arrival screen (Q-23TD9). On build 0.1.456375 the bridge log shows '22:26:48 reply 1 items' then '22:26:48 phone: arrival shown: 1 items' (speaker on). The speaker-off path (silent arrival + silent walk) is not yet observed on the phone.

answers.observed: Phone prefs speak=false (run-as genlock-ui.xml); bridge log 22:26:48 'phone: arrival shown: 1 items' on 0.1.456375; tests 47/47 bridge, WalkPlanTest 17/17
answers.cause: Measured: the speak gate at MainActivity onReply was read in code and the pref was false on the phone; TJ confirmed the symptom (no arrival, still reads). YOU SAID cause read in Link.kt and matched to the 21:03:36 unprompted reply
answers.absence: Speaker-off path not yet seen on device: no 'speaker off' diag line yet; absence of evidence, not a failure
answers.assumption: Mine: speaker off should mean a silent walk, not no walk. TJ's message implies it but he has not confirmed the silent behaviour
answers.falsify: A reply with the speaker off that logs 'arrival skipped' or reads aloud; or a YOU SAID on a relay-report item after the bridge restart
